create_chameleon_processor: create a ChameleonProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal input processing
call_chameleon_processor: call the ChameleonProcessor to tokenize text with image tokens and process images into pixel values
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for a list of image sizes using _get_num_multimodal_tokens
configure_text_completion_kwargs: configure ChameleonTextKwargs to control separator token appending for text completion versus chat mode
configure_processor_kwargs: configure ChameleonProcessorKwargs with padding, return_tensors, and return_mm_token_type_ids options
